tests: Whether the breakdown surfaces per-action tool cost: a high-volume CRM agent whose stripe.create_charge + template emails add a visible (~45% of LLM) tool-cost line on top of the LLM spend.

expected_truth.how_computed: Model claude-sonnet-4-6: input $3.00/MTok = 3e-6/tok, output $15.00/MTok = 15e-6/tok, cache_discount 0.90, tokenizer_inflation 1.0. raw_llm = 2200*3e-6 + 350*15e-6 = 0.0066 + 0.00525 = 0.01185. cache_mult = 1 - 0.40*0.90 = 0.64. retry_mult = 1 + 0.04 = 1.04. llm_per_call = 0.01185 * 0.64 * 1.04 = 0.00788736. tool_per_call = sum(share*unit_cost) at real-world API prices: stripe.create_charge 0.12*0.029 = 0.00348, plus email.send_template_email 0.25*0.0004 = 0.0001, = 0.00358 (hubspot/calendly actions carry no per-call API cost, so 0). infra_per_call = 0.001. monthly = 500 calls/day * 30 days * (0.00788736 + 0.00358 + 0.001) = 15000 * 0.01246736 = 187.0104. monthly_range = 187.0104 * [0.85, 1.15] = [158.9588, 215.062]. NOTE: Arceo keys tool cost by tool NAME and only 'stripe' is in its pricing table, so Arceo will report tool_per_call = 0.00348 (stripe only) and miss the $0.0001/call email cost — an intentional finding (see README 'Known forecaster gaps this fleet exposes').

why_low_tier_will_miss: The LOW tier assumes 100 calls/day (vs the real 500), a static token estimate, and a uniform tool distribution that ignores the 12% stripe.create_charge share, so it will under-forecast both the LLM base (5x volume gap) and drop most of the ~$0.00358/call tool contribution; convergence means the forecast climbs toward ~$187/mo once real call volume and the charge-action mix are observed.

register_payload.name: Sales CRM Closer
register_payload.description: High-volume sales/CRM automation agent: updates HubSpot deals, creates contacts, sends template follow-up emails, books meetings via Calendly, and charges closed deals through Stripe. ~500 calls/day.

actions.name: update_deal
actions.description: Advance or update a deal stage/amount in the pipeline

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Create a new CRM contact from an inbound lead

actions.name: add_note
actions.description: Attach a note to a contact or deal

actions.name: send_template_email
actions.description: Send a templated follow-up or outreach email to a prospect

actions.name: create_invite_link
actions.description: Generate a Calendly invite link to book a sales meeting

actions.name: create_charge
actions.description: Charge a customer when a deal closes
